exposure: gestational age at delivery (preterm, late preterm, term)
outcome: timing of ACS administration relative to delivery
cohort: All women who delivered at a tertiary hospital between January 2011 and December 2015.
finding: A significant number of women and babies were exposed to ACS without commensurate benefit, while a significant number who delivered preterm did not receive ACS.
gest_age: Preterm (<37 weeks), late preterm (34-36 weeks), and term (>=37 weeks)
